messages:
Sam (AE): Quick sync — FinServCo asking if we can do EU-only residency with an opt-in UK DR region. They want KMS in their account (BYOK), list of subprocessors limited to EU, and a price delta for geofence routing. Also pending security questionnaire Q12 about subprocessor locations. Can we scope a POC and an estimate?
Priya (SRE): Short answer: yes, with caveats. We have two routing options: 1) tenant pinning to region (hard pin) or 2) policy-based prefer-eu fallback-uk deny-us. Tenant pinning requires Dedicated or Private with tenancy config. BYOK KMS is supported for Private + Dedicated via our KMS connector — Hosted supports customer-managed KMS in limited regions only. Need customer's AWS account id and key policy.
Luca (Solutions): For POC I suggest: create a dedicated eu-west-1 tenant for the test, configure routing policy:
```
{"routing":{"prefer":["eu-west-1"],"fallback":["eu-west-2"],"deny":["us-*"]}}
```
We'll run traffic and validate 0% egress to US. Also can enable KV-prefix caching to keep latency low.
Sam (AE): What's the pricing delta vs standard Hosted? they want a line item for the SOW.
Priya (SRE): Ballpark: Hosted EU-only routing (software policy) == no price change but with potential egress costs if cross-region; Dedicated tenant reserve + region pinning adds ~30–40% uplift depending on commit. If BYOK + KMS peering in customer's account, add flat one-time integration (PM + security review) ~ $8k–15k.
Luca (Solutions): Added detail: for Dedicated we estimate capacity for their stated load (2k rps) -> monthly commit $XXk (I'll follow up with exact numbers). For POC we can do a short 2-week trial on our infra with restricted subnet. Expect egress audit log at: `s3://redwood-poc-logs/2321004567/egress-report.csv`.
Nina (Legal): We need the subprocessor attestation. Sales, please send customer the latest subproc list link + DPA/Annex for data residency. If they require EU-only subprocessors, flag: some infra vendors in backup/observability are US-based — that will require an exception or Private deployment.
Sam (AE): Copied. I'll share subproc link + security questionnaire placeholder. Any config I should ask customer for now?
Priya (SRE): Yes: (1) AWS account id for KMS, (2) preferred failover region (eu-west-2?), (3) allowed egress CIDRs for peering, (4) SLA targets (p99/p95), (5) expected QPS and median sequence length, (6) whether logs can be stored in their region.
Luca (Solutions): Also ask whether they need IP allowlists or VPC peering, and if they'd accept our Managed Dedicated (we can do quicker onboarding).
Sam (AE): Thanks. I'll ping them now.
deploy-bot: scheduled private-poc-deploy to eu-west-1 at 2023-09-12T10:00Z for thread 2321004567
Sam (AE): Update: customer sent account id + QPS numbers. Next: Priya can we spin a POC tenant next week? :crossed_fingers:
Priya (SRE): Yes — we'll provision a temporary tenant, enable routing policy deny-us, wire KMS access, and run the failover test. Timeline: 5 business days for infra + 3 days for security review. I'll send the checklist.
Sam (AE): Perfect. Nina can you confirm DPA addendum for BYOK?
Nina (Legal): I'll draft the addendum and confirm subproc checklist. Expect a note tomorrow.
Sam (AE): Awesome. Will update the deal room and attach this thread. :thumbsup:
